variants.core:
Hand 將相位視為符號之間的有效角度關係：當兩個點形成重要角度時，兩種行星能量會結合、衝突，或讓某種能量找到可表現的生活領域。這支持 Valley 用合盤相位作為關係互動證據，而不是單一行星或星座配對。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-001)

相位角度本身也有自己的象徵意義；不同角度會改變兩個行星功能互動的方式。因此 runtime 不應只讀「Venus-Mars」或「Moon-Saturn」，還要保留 aspect type、orb、directionality 與是否 hard/soft。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-002)

Hand 對 orb 的說明很重要：orb 不是開關，越接近 exact 通常越有力，遠離 exact 應視為更細微的連結。這支持我們的 aspect priority：優先選 tight orb 與高相關訊號，避免把很寬的相位當成 full force 證據。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-003)

Hard aspects 也不能被簡化成「壞」。Hand 說二系列/hard aspects 具有動態、需要行動與改變的特質；它們會帶來困難，但也可能是創造性改變的來源。這支持 breakup reading 將壓力寫成「卡住機制」而不是「沒有愛」。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-004)
variants.in_breakup: 分手情境中，相位基礎層最常用於解釋「為什麼還有牽動卻互動卡住」。Hard aspects、Saturn pressure 或 Mercury friction 應被寫成需要行動/調整的機制，不應被升級成「他一定不愛」或「你們一定會復合」。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-001, western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-003, western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-004)
variants.in_relationship:
關係中，相位基礎層應先回答「哪兩個功能在互動、互動方式是融合、支持、摩擦還是對立、orb 是否夠緊」。這讓 attraction、emotionalSafety、pressure、communication、repair 的分類更穩定。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-001, western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-002, western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-003)

### 優勢

- 支援 deterministic aspect priority，而不是 dump all aspects。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-003)
- 讓 hard aspects 被寫成需要處理的能量，而不是固定負面判決。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-004)

### 弱點

- 相位只說明互動機制，不直接證明承諾、聯絡或復合。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-001)
- Wide orb 或低相關相位必須降權，不能用來補足想要的故事。(claims: western-aspect-interpretation-foundation-003)

同一個 planet pair 不能只因為 pair family 相同就產生同一種敘事。Hand 說不同 aspect angle 有自己的象徵，會改變兩個行星功能互動的方式；因此 runtime 必須保留 conjunction、soft、hard 與 orb，而不是只寫「Moon-Mars」或「Sun-Venus」。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-001, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-005)

Soft contact 包含 trine 與 sextile。它可以支援比較容易流動、較少阻抗、較適合低壓修復的語氣，但不能被升級成「一定會復合」或「對方一定會回應」。Soft contact 是條件式入口，不是結果保證。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-002)

Hard contact 包含 square、opposition 與 quincunx。它應被寫成摩擦、張力、調整需求與整合可能，而不是固定負面判決。Hard contact 可以說明「為什麼卡住」，不能直接說成「沒有愛」或「必定分開」。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-003)

Conjunction 需要獨立處理。George/Bloch 將 conjunction 視為中性，會依 involved planets 而走向融合、增強、競爭或忽略。關係閱讀中，conjunction 應寫成兩個功能直接疊合與強化，不應自動歸類為 soft 或 hard。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-004)
variants.in_breakup: 分手、冷戰或斷聯情境中，contact type 是降低 hallucination 的關鍵。Hard contact 可說明為什麼靠近時容易刺痛或防衛；soft contact 可說明低壓入口；conjunction 可說明強度與直接牽動。但三者都不能獨立推論對方內心、回覆日期、承諾或復合結果。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-002, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-003, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-004, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-005)
variants.in_relationship:
在仍有互動的關係裡，modifier 要回答「這個 pair 怎麼發生」：

- conjunction：兩個功能直接疊合，強度高，但需要看 pair 本身是吸引、安全、溝通還是壓力。
- soft：互動比較容易流動，適合寫成可協調入口，但仍需實際行動配合。
- hard：互動帶張力，適合拆卡住機制、觸發點與需要調整的方式。

這能避免把 Sun-Venus hard 寫得太甜、把 Moon-Mars soft 寫得太危險，或把 Mars-Mars conjunction 當成單純好壞判斷。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-001, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-002, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-003, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-004)

### 優勢

- 讓同一 pair family 可以根據 aspect type 產生不同 reducer 語氣。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-001)
- 支援「有吸引但 hard contact 卡住」和「有壓力但 soft contact 可協調」這類更細分的關係結果。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-002, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-003)
- 保留 conjunction 的強度與不確定性，不硬塞進 soft/hard 二分。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-004)

### 弱點

- Modifier 不能覆蓋 planet pair 本身的功能，也不能覆蓋 birth precision、orb 或 relationship context。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-001, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-005)
- Hard contact 不是壞結果；soft contact 不是修復保證；conjunction 不是命定。(claims: western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-002, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-003, western-aspect-contact-type-modifiers-004)

variants.core:
Mercury contacts are the relationship layer for words, interpretation, curiosity, argument style, and whether two people can make their inner experience understandable to each other. They should not be treated as proof of love or proof of breakup, but they are essential when the user asks why messages became cold, why the other person misunderstood, or whether contact could be reopened. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-001)

Mercury-Mercury contacts are the direct mental-compatibility layer: soft or conjunction contacts can support shared interests and easier conversation, while hard contacts can describe different approaches to the same problem. This should change the communication reading, not become a verdict about the whole relationship. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-006)

Moon-Mercury contacts are especially useful when the emotional layer and verbal layer do not move at the same speed. A difficult Moon-Mercury contact can describe a pattern where one person is speaking from feeling while the other is answering from logic, so the product should translate the mismatch rather than blame either person. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-002)

Mercury-Mars contacts can sharpen conversation. In easy forms this can create fast exchange and useful challenge; in hard forms, the same speed can become defensiveness, irritation, or the feeling that every message is a fight. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-003)

Mercury-Saturn contacts can stabilize thinking and bring realism, but they can also make communication slow, judged, or over-edited. In breakup and cold-war readings, this is a strong candidate for "why they do not answer directly" without claiming that silence proves love. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-004)

Mercury-Venus contacts support pleasant or affectionate conversation, but they still need pressure and emotional safety context. A sweet way of speaking can lower tension; it does not guarantee commitment or repair. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-005)
variants.in_breakup: In breakup, cold-war, or no-contact scenarios, Mercury contacts should be used to identify the communication gate: whether silence is more likely pressure, misunderstanding, mental overload, or fear of saying the wrong thing. The free page may describe the gate and the risk of pushing too hard; it should not give a full message script or a guaranteed response date. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-001, western-aspects-mercury-contacts-003, western-aspects-mercury-contacts-004)
variants.in_relationship:
In an active relationship, Mercury contacts explain how two people negotiate repair after a trigger: whether they can name the issue, whether criticism lands as attack, whether affection can be verbalized, and whether a practical conversation helps or shuts one person down. Use this layer for "what happened between us" and "how should we talk" questions, while keeping message templates for the paid report. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-001, western-aspects-mercury-contacts-003, western-aspects-mercury-contacts-004)

### 優勢

- Can explain why a short message changes the emotional climate quickly. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-001)
- Can separate communication mismatch from lack of feeling. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-002)

- Mercury evidence alone cannot decide whether the relationship should continue. (claims: western-aspects-mercury-contacts-001)
